title: Y像素
description: 一个简单的 Minecraft 生存服务器，提供原版生存体验。
body:
**本服务器与任何其他服务器无任何关系，不代表他们的观点或他们本身。请仔细甄别。**

**This server is not affiliated with any other server in any way, nor does it represent their views or the entity itself. Please discern carefully.**

这是一个简单的生存服务器。简而言之，没有任何复杂的功能，我们提供的只是贴近原版的 Minecraft 体验。

This is a simple survival server. In short, there are no complex features; we only offer a vanilla-adjacent Minecraft experience.

服务器不欢迎作弊，即使您可以，也不要这样做。尊重他人和他们的成果、不要攻击服务器。您需要使用 1.13+ Java版来加入服务器，出于兼容性原因，在肉眼可见的将来，我们不会支持基岩版。

Cheating is not welcome on the server. Even if you can, don't do it. Respect others and their work, and do not attack the server. You need to use Java Edition 1.13+ to join. For compatibility reasons, we will not support Bedrock Edition for the foreseeable future.

服务器内部具有领地保护，只提供基本的保护。服务器的设置经过微调，可能不能保证兼容所有的红石机器、农场等。欢迎您加入。

The server has land protection, providing only basic protection. Server settings have been fine-tuned and may not guarantee compatibility with all redstone machines, farms, etc. You are welcome to join.
